decisions.reason: The guided historic mill tour still fits the firm's heritage, premises and hospitality know-how, but because it is less central than baked goods and harder to refine through the firm's core product knowledge, it faces the highest withdrawal risk of the remaining launches.
A sweet pastry is very close to the firm's existing confectionery skills, recipes and customer base, so management can readily judge demand, make small improvements and keep it in the assortment.

The crusty farmhouse bread builds directly on the firm's breadmaking capabilities, regional ingredient sourcing and traditional positioning, which gives strong absorptive capacity for incremental improvement and continued sale.

The poppy seed Christmas stollen is closely tied to the firm's established seasonal expertise and was highlighted as a flagship with a gold award, so management is very likely to retain and further develop it.

The premium Christmas stollen also draws on the firm's core seasonal baking knowledge and received a gold award, though it is slightly more exposed to portfolio rationalisation than the flagship poppy seed variant.
